categories.main_business_segments: Tekken Corporation operates four main business segments: civil engineering (土木工事), building construction (建築工事), real estate (不動産事業), and ancillary businesses (付帯事業). The civil engineering and building construction segments are the core, focusing on public and private infrastructure and building projects. The real estate segment handles property sales, leasing, and development, while ancillary businesses provide materials, security, and support services related to construction projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced construction technologies, including ICT and DX (digital transformation) for productivity, safety, and quality improvements. Notable innovations include portable LiDAR-based machine guidance for non-GNSS environments, precast construction methods for railway viaducts, and sustainable materials such as low-CO2 concrete and geopolymer concrete. Tekken also develops hybrid structural methods (RC columns with steel beams) and advanced seismic dampers for buildings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tekken's primary customers are public sector entities (such as national and local governments), railway companies (notably JR East), and private corporations requiring infrastructure or building construction. The company is particularly strong in railway-related projects, but also serves highway, logistics, office, and residential markets. In FY2025, JR East accounted for about 22% of total completed contract value.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan, with a nationwide network of branches and offices, and a small but growing presence in Asia (notably Vietnam and Bangladesh). Over 97% of revenue is generated in Japan, with the remainder from overseas projects. Major domestic offices are located in Tokyo, Sapporo, Sendai, Saitama, Nagoya, Osaka, and Fukuoka.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tekken operates as a midstream and downstream player in the construction supply chain, acting as a general contractor for civil engineering and building projects. It manages project design, procurement, and execution, sourcing materials and specialized services from group companies and external suppliers, and delivering completed infrastructure and buildings to end clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include restoring and strengthening productivity and profitability, investing in growth areas, enhancing human capital and ESG initiatives, and improving capital efficiency. R&D focuses on construction DX, automation, sustainable construction methods, and safety. The company is also investing in talent development, diversity, and digital skills, with a strong emphasis on sustainability and CO2 reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Tekken generates revenue primarily through fixed-price and competitive-bid construction contracts for civil engineering and building projects. Additional revenue streams include real estate sales and leasing, as well as ancillary services such as materials sales and facility management. Revenue is recognized based on project progress (percentage-of-completion method) and upon delivery for real estate transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major Japanese general contractors such as Kajima, Obayashi, Shimizu, and Taisei, as well as specialized railway and infrastructure builders like East Japan Railway Construction and Tokyu Construction. Tekken is positioned as a mid-sized contractor with particular strength in railway-related civil engineering, leveraging close ties with JR East and other railway operators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥185.1 billion, with operating profit of ¥3.5 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥3.4 billion. The company has around 1,871 employees. Growth is stable but modest, with a focus on profitability improvement and capital efficiency. The order backlog remains robust, but profit margins are under pressure from rising costs and competitive bidding.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tekken differentiates itself through its expertise in railway-related construction, advanced safety and quality management, and adoption of digital and sustainable construction technologies. The company emphasizes reliability, technical innovation, and the ability to deliver complex infrastructure projects safely and efficiently, particularly in challenging environments such as operating railways and urban centers.
